question: When I bring my Notion workspace over, what happens to its databases?
evidence: Pages, nested pages as folders, databases as tables

question: My laptop went to sleep halfway through a big import. Do I have to start again from the beginning?
evidence: the importer resumes from the last note it finished writing

question: Which encoding is assumed for imported files that are not valid UTF-8?
evidence: Files that are not valid UTF-8 are read as Windows-1252

question: How can I preview which links the importer would repair without changing anything?
evidence: quill import fix-links --dry-run --vault ~/Notes

question: For how long can I still take back an import I regret?
evidence: The snapshot taken before the import is kept for 14 days

question: Which role lets a reviewer leave remarks without touching the wording?
evidence: Read every note and leave comments, without changing the text

question: How long does an invitation link stay valid?
evidence: an invitation link stops working after seven days

question: Is there a cap on how many people can belong to one shared notebook?
evidence: A shared notebook can have up to 50 members, counting the owner

question: How far back can I go to see earlier versions of a shared note?
evidence: version history keeps every saved change for 90 days

question: Where do resolved comments go once a discussion is finished?
evidence: Resolved comments are hidden from the margin but remain in the note's history

question: Which template placeholder decides where I start typing in the new note?
evidence: The place where typing continues after the template is inserted

question: How do I keep an old template around without it showing up when I pick one?
evidence: move it to a subfolder named Archive inside the Templates folder

question: How can several templates reuse the same block of text?
evidence: put it in a template of its own and include it with the include variable

question: In the example weekly review rule, when does it run?
evidence: schedule: every Friday at 16:00

question: I was away for a week with the app shut. Will my daily rule create seven notes when I come back?
evidence: rules that miss their time while Quill is closed run once at the next start

question: Which command rebuilds the search index with four threads?
evidence: quill index rebuild --threads 4 --vault ~/Notes

question: Why does search miss words inside my enormous pasted log note?
evidence: notes larger than 5 MB are indexed by title only

question: Roughly how much disk space does the search index take up?
evidence: it uses about a tenth of the space taken up by the notes themselves

question: What does the cache size setting actually control?
evidence: Memory kept for recently opened notes before the oldest are dropped

question: My vault is gigantic and the sidebar keeps working hard. Which feature should I switch off?
evidence: Vaults with more than 100,000 notes should turn off live backlink counts
